scope: Reference-sample lag-1 autocorrelation of the within-firm quarterly p-values on the normal-score scale of the AR(1) copula null. Published only; the calibration rho is not changed.
_note: rho_calibration parameterises the AR(1) copula, so it compares with rho_hat_copula; the indicator autocorrelations are a different scale and are reported for the tau grid the firm statistic counts.
